$comment: The generic error a legacy server returns when it receives tools/list before initialize (the 2025-* reference implementations use -32602). It has a JSON-RPC shape but **no modern protocol marker at all** (no io.modelcontextprotocol/, _meta, MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp- header name or resultType, and no data.supported), so it counts as unrecognisable and the client must fall back to initialize. Counter-example: a client that treats any JSON-RPC body as modern would never fall back and could not connect to existing legacy servers.

error.message: Received request before initialization was complete
